body:
In the agent panel, pressing Ctrl+A selects all the text in the whole app. It should select only the conversation's text.

The agent panel (`plan_panel`) is shared by the Strategy page and the Design page's Agent tab, so the change applies to both.

The message box is unchanged: Ctrl+A there still selects only what's typed in it.
title: agent panel: Ctrl+A selects only the conversation
